v0_3_0_role_permissions: System administrators can now choose operation permissions for each existing role.
v0_3_0_detail_notes: You can now enter Notes when creating or editing records that have a detail view. The entered Notes are available in the detail view.
v0_2_0_optional_samples: Added guided English/Japanese installers for Windows, macOS and Linux, with optional fictional sample data for evaluation.
v0_2_0_consolidated_initialization: Improved updates and restores for existing installations with verified backups and encryption key checks.
v0_3_0_development_notice: Version 0.3.0 is a development release. Features, including existing ones, may change significantly in future updates.
v0_3_0_us_federal_holidays: Work calendars can now automatically import U.S. federal holiday data from the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) when they are created or their holidays are refreshed.
v0_3_0_sample_calendar_holidays: Optional installer samples now import the current year's official Japanese and U.S. holidays when available. If a source is unavailable, other samples are still installed and you can refresh holidays later.
v0_3_0_visible_list_search: Improved search in data list pages.
v0_3_0_os_vendor_master: Operating system vendors now have their own master list. Choose a vendor when registering an OS, and manage vendor names separately from asset manufacturers.
v0_3_0_employee_average_age: Added average age to employee analytics. You can view it on the dashboard.
v0_2_1_japan_holiday_translation: Japanese holiday names now appear in English when English is selected as the display language.
v0_3_0_accessible_font_sizes: Adjusted font sizes throughout the system to make text easier to read for people with age-related vision changes.
v0_3_0_master_management_consolidation: Consolidated master management from 12 pages into 3 pages to make it easier to maintain. You can also change the order of master records by dragging them.
v0_3_0_top_pagination: Added page navigation links to the top of data lists, so you can move through consecutive pages without adjusting your click position.
v0_3_0_system_information_page: Moved System information from System settings to its own page.
v0_3_0_social_links: Removed Website and Blog from the social links you can add in Settings, and added Threads, Bluesky and Mastodon.
v0_3_0_status_notices: Standardized the display style of informational, warning, and error messages throughout the system.
v0_3_0_assigned_work_calendars: Work calendars were changed to show only calendars assigned to the signed-in user. However, system administrators always see all calendars.
v0_3_0_it_asset_assignee_selector: IT asset employee assignment choices now show names alongside employee codes, making it easier to distinguish employees with the same name.
v0_3_0_modal_picker_visibility: Fixed date pickers and employee department/position menus being hidden by form modal footers.
v0_3_0_powershell_75_installation: Fixed new installations failing during database initialization when install.ps1 is run from PowerShell 7.5 or later.
v0_3_0_powershell_maintenance: Fixed the Windows backup, update, and restore scripts failing in Windows PowerShell 5.1.
v0_3_0_external_links_mobile_layout: Fixed the External links table heading becoming cramped on narrow screens.
v0_3_0_master_history_relationship: Fixed employee ID changes failing under certain conditions.
v0_3_0_api_dependency_security: Updated API dependencies to address known high-severity security advisories.
v0_3_0_sidebar_navigation_flicker: Fixed the sidebar flickering during page navigation.
v0_2_1_localhost_https: Fixed some data registration actions requiring HTTPS when the system is running on localhost.
v0_2_0_dashboard_pdf_export: Added an employee dashboard for headcount, age groups and turnover, with PDF export of summaries and charts.
v0_2_0_localization: Added English/Japanese display across major pages, shared navigation and master management.
v0_2_0_it_asset_credentials: Added IT asset network details and encrypted password management, including a Server Administrator role and reauthentication before password display.
v0_2_0_employee_visibility: Added options to include retired and deleted employees in lists and CSV exports, with read-only details for deleted employees.
v0_1_0_system_information: Added product version, release notice, public repository, and revision history information to System settings.
v0_1_0_backup_and_recovery: Added verified full-database backup, update, and disaster-recovery tools for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
v0_1_0_role_management: Added role name management and replaced editable role codes with immutable permission identifiers.
v0_1_0_work_calendars: Improved Work calendars with automatic public-holiday imports and responsive employee assignment controls.
v0_1_0_employee_name_formatting: Added language-aware employee name formatting and localized gender and length-of-service labels.
v0_1_0_employee_email_and_asset_notes: Added employee email actions and made IT asset notes easier to identify.
v0_1_0_responsive_layouts: Improved responsive layouts across Settings, System settings, master data, and asset management screens.
v0_1_0_active_data_transfer: Added a separate active-data export and restore workflow that preserves database date values without time-zone shifts.
